mapper.sql: id, exam_id, student_id, attempt_number, start_time, submit_time, duration, total_score, objective_score, subjective_score, pass_status, ip_address, status, -- teacher_comment, -- 数据库中没有此字段，暂时移除 create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT er.id, er.exam_id, er.student_id, er.attempt_number, er.start_time, er.submit_time, er.duration, er.total_score, er.objective_score, er.subjective_score, er.pass_status, er.ip_address, er.status, er.create_time, er.update_time, s.real_name AS student_name, s.student_no AS student_no FROM exam_record er LEFT JOIN student s ON er.student_id = s.id WHERE er.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY er.total_score DESC, er.submit_time DESC

SELECT er.id, er.exam_id, er.student_id, er.attempt_number, er.start_time, er.submit_time, er.duration, er.total_score, er.objective_score, er.subjective_score, er.pass_status, er.ip_address, er.status, er.create_time, er.update_time, e.title AS exam_title, e.description AS exam_description, e.start_time AS exam_start_time, -- 查询考试的开始时间 e.end_time AS exam_end_time, -- 查询考试的结束时间 s.real_name AS student_name FROM exam_record er LEFT JOIN exam e ON er.exam_id = e.id LEFT JOIN student s ON er.student_id = s.id WHERE er.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY er.create_time DESC
